evals.prompt: dry run: go through the review comments on __PR_URL__ and tell me what you'd fix and what you'd skip
evals.expected_output: Lists unresolved threads, classifies agent vs human authors, makes fixes locally only, prints the summary table and drafted replies, posts nothing to GitHub.

evals.prompt: copilot left a bunch of suggestions on __PR_URL__ - handle them, but this is a dry run so don't push or comment anything
evals.expected_output: Focuses on Copilot/bot threads, uses DRY_RUN=1 for replies/resolves, gives a reason for every skipped agent comment, no commits pushed.

evals.prompt: preview only: address the PR feedback on __PR_URL__, and for anything from my colleagues that you won't fix, draft me an answer
evals.expected_output: Human skipped comments get original text, reason and drafted polite reply presented for approval; nothing posted.
